title: Inspect authored content through a safe local reviewer
statement: As a reviewer, I can inspect authored content through a local, isolated application, so that reviewing an untrusted branch does not expose my machine or silently contact external services.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The review application refuses a non-loopback listening address.
The review application rejects requests with a foreign host.
The review application rejects cross-site requests.
Interactive authored content cannot access the parent review application.
Interactive authored content cannot make network requests.
Browser errors do not expose local filesystem paths.
The review application enforces bounded request and response resources.
